source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: With [Synaptic Goading](vsdata:ability/tyranids.unending-swarm.synaptic-goading), an **ENDLESS MULTITUDE** unit in [Synapse](vsdata:ability/tyranids.synapse) Range can re-roll its **[Surge move](vsdata:core-rule/surge-move)**’s D6 before it moves. It may also head toward the closest [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) in place of the usual move toward the closest enemy unit.
